sections.title: Beach film · Last Light
sections.label: Draft cuts · tap play for sound
sections.note: Sunset to bonfire night on the beach. Every draft, newest first, with what changed since the one before it and the machine that rendered it.

items.title: Draft v0.3
items.rendered: Mac mini M4 · Blender Cycles on Metal · 32 samples
items.tldr: First look pass. Director score up from 5.6 to 6.7.
changes: Golden hour sits lower and warmer, with a real orange sun
Driftwood and beach debris added along the sand
Discs are bigger and read in flight
Campfire lights the friends shot instead of leaving it near black
The bottle's colour holds through the first throw
PICK YOUR LIGHT SHOW. now clears the rainbow pole

items.title: Draft v0.2
items.rendered: Mac mini M4 · Blender Cycles on Metal · 32 samples
items.tldr: Four review fixes on the same timing as v0.1.
changes: Bottle no longer picks up a tint from a stray light
End card uses the rainbow logo with a white wordmark
Camp shots lose their orange cast
PICK YOUR LIGHT SHOW. moved clear of the phone

items.title: Draft v0.1
items.rendered: Mac mini M4 · Blender Cycles on Metal · 32 samples
items.tldr: First full cut: 24 shots from golden hour to the bonfire game, on the music grid.

items.title: Final v2.4
items.meta: 1:03 · 720p web copy of the 1080p final · music
items.rendered: Mac mini M4 · Blender Cycles on Metal · 1080p, all 1516 frames
items.tldr: Every frame is now the final render. No draft frames left.
changes: Rule card reads FIRST TO TWENTY ONE. / WIN BY TWO.
Shots with out-of-focus lights render at higher quality to clean up the bokeh

items.title: Test cut v2.4

items.tldr: About a third is the new final render. The rest is the earlier draft, marked DRAFT in the corner.
